note: The two sets contain essentially the same 22 claims, differing only in ordering and trivial entity naming (e.g., A's 'Lynx mirror assembly | focal length | 10 m' vs B's 'Lynx | focal length | 10 m', and 'instrument count' vs 'science instrument count'). Both correctly capture the baseline telescope/mirror diameters, focal length, instrument counts and the 52 m starshade. Both share the same defects: truncated entities ('n-axis telescope', 'axis telescope'), the 10 m focal length misbound as a mirror-assembly dimension/diameter, the Lynx instrument count misbound to the mirror assembly, a vague 'spacecraft' entity, and duplicated starshade claims.
remarks: Shared defects in both sets: 'n-axis telescope' and 'axis telescope' are truncated fragments of 'on-axis'/'off-axis telescope' (misread entities); 'grazing incidence mirror assembly | dimension/diameter | 10 m' misreads the 10 m focal length as a size (the assembly diameter is 3 m); 'grazing incidence mirror assembly | science instrument count | 3' misbinds the Lynx instrument count to the mirror assembly; 'spacecraft | science instrument count | 4' and the bare 'on-axis/off-axis telescope' entities are vague; the 52 m starshade claim appears twice in each set. Both sets also drop the 'flying in formation' condition on the starshade and the fact that it is a separate spacecraft.
